results.source_quote: Eligible borrowers are SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs aged 18 years and above.
The scheme specifically targets SC/ST, OBC, women, and minority entrepreneurs.
The beneficiary family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
Eligible vendors are those vending in urban areas as on or before March 24, 2020, who possess a Certificate of Vending (CoV) or Identity Card issued by the Urban Local Body (ULB).
